phases.name: Local-first environment certification and production-safe promotion
phases.objective: Certify Local/Dev on development using Prisma + SQLite, then certify Staging end-to-end on isolated Neon PostgreSQL before any Production promotion.
exit_criteria: Local/Dev runs from development with Prisma + a gitignored SQLite database and VSN | Stock Down Sort Dev.
Local and hosted Prisma schemas have an explicit parity contract for shared application data.
The four-plan billing catalog is implemented with stable IDs and 10-day trials.
Dedicated Staging Shopify identity is verified.
Staging Worker, Neon PostgreSQL and Queue/DLQ are healthy.
Staging Shopify auth/session/Admin API reads pass.
The four-plan billing catalog contract is verified in hosted environments.
Production remains unmodified until Staging acceptance evidence exists.

Local credentials do not reuse Staging or Production database identities.

work_units.title: Convert and certify Local Dev on Prisma SQLite
work_units.objective: Convert VSN | Stock Down Sort Dev on development to Shopify-default-style Prisma + SQLite while preserving Prisma + Neon PostgreSQL for Staging and Production.
acceptance_criteria: development remains the Local integration branch.
VSN | Stock Down Sort Dev remains the Local Shopify identity.
Local Prisma datasource uses SQLite and a gitignored local database file.
Normal Local development requires no NEON_API_KEY, NEON_PROJECT_ID, DATABASE_URL to Neon, DIRECT_URL to Neon, or Staging/Production database credentials.
prisma/schema.prisma is the Local SQLite schema and prisma/cloud/schema.prisma remains the hosted PostgreSQL schema.
Shared application models, required fields, relations and indexes are covered by an automated schema-parity contract.
Local setup/generation/migration succeeds on Windows.
npm run dev boots successfully against Local SQLite.
Local health/certification proves development environment, test billing, SQLite persistence and exact source ref.
SQLite Local success is not treated as PostgreSQL acceptance; Staging remains the first required Neon/PostgreSQL runtime acceptance gate.
completion_evidence: ADR-0001 accepted Local Prisma+SQLite with hosted Neon PostgreSQL.
prisma/schema.prisma is SQLite; prisma/cloud/schema.prisma remains PostgreSQL.
Local Session.shop index migration added and shared Local/cloud models are parity-checked.
Local prepare/dev/certify no longer require Neon credentials or hosted database URLs.
Operational development-flow/topology/gates now specify SQLite locally and Neon PostgreSQL when hosted.
Obsolete Local Neon provision/validation scripts were removed.
App Validation #271 run 36844916383 passed the implementation tree b0970d0dbe4a0556543770f5755f72f529dc62aa.

work_units.title: Implement four-plan billing contract
work_units.objective: Replace the single-plan runtime with four stable plan IDs, 10-day trials, capability-aware entitlements and legacy subscription compatibility.
acceptance_criteria: Exactly starter/growth/pro/unlimited are canonical IDs.
Prices are 10.99/19.99/34.99/54.99 USD every 30 days.
Every plan has a 10-day trial.
Plan changes use Shopify replacement behavior.
Legacy USD 55/5-day subscription remains recognized.
Unimplemented capabilities are not represented as available runtime entitlements.
CI verifies the catalog and billing implementation contracts.
completion_evidence: config/ai/product-plan.json is canonical.
config/ai/options-bank.json contains all referenced options and runtime implementation status.
app/billing-config.ts derives runtime catalog from the canonical files.
app/services/billing.server.ts resolves all four plans and legacy compatibility.
/app/plans exposes all four tiers and prevents unknown active subscription changes.
Subscription API supports plan selection and replacement.
Hosted health/release workflows validate the four-plan catalog.
App Validation #224 passed the previous billing contract before this implementation batch.
Real Dev-store four-plan runtime acceptance passed on development source fde5a26bd8d0c287ab3fcf6e9b1d882e0bd7eb5c.
Starter/Growth/Pro/Unlimited plan-change approvals were exercised across the current plan flow.
Each selected plan returned from Shopify approval and was recognized as Current plan.
The merchant restored the original desired current plan after the switch checks.
PR #76 plan-switch fetcher revalidation fix passed App Validation #301 before merge.

work_units.title: Harden hosted PostgreSQL data architecture
work_units.objective: Verify and harden the Staging/Production cloud PostgreSQL schema and indexing while Local uses a separate SQLite development schema.
acceptance_criteria: Hosted Prisma schema uses PostgreSQL.
Staging and Production database identities remain isolated.
Shopify Session lookup by shop is indexed in the hosted schema.
Migration is additive and reversible by standard migration rollback/forward procedure.
Local SQLite does not reuse hosted database credentials.
completion_evidence: config/database/environment-topology.json enforces Local -> Staging -> Production isolation.
Session.shop index added to prisma/cloud/schema.prisma.
Additive migration 20261001003000_session_shop_index added.
Database architecture contract test added to App Validation.
Local/cloud Prisma shared-model parity contract added and passed in App Validation #271.
Local SQLite and hosted PostgreSQL providers are now explicitly separated under ADR-0001.
